svg.title: Causal multi-head self-attention, animated
svg.desc: A decoder-only transformer generates 'every neuron has a different opinion' token by token: attention arcs from each query to earlier tokens for three heads, the causal attention matrices filling row by row, the KV cache growing, the softmax over candidate next tokens, and the forward pass through RMSNorm, GQA with RoPE, and a Mixture-of-Experts SwiGLU block.

g.text: 01 · HOW AN LLM PICKS THE NEXT TOKEN

text.tspan: query “has” attends to its past · reuses cached K,V
every neuron has a different opinion.

g.text: one forward pass per generated token
